babs.1: Guarantee for loans and debts, of persons and otherwise
babs.2: The saying of Allah the Exalted: "And those with whom you have made pledges, give them their share"
babs.3: One who guarantees a deceased person's debt cannot go back on it
babs.4: Abū Bakr's protection in the time of the Prophet ﷺ and his pact
